newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel would like more U.S. military aid.
newsitem.headline: Israel would like more U.S. military aid.

text.p: Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai was quoted in an interview on Friday as saying he would like an increase in the current $1.8 billion in annual U.S. military aid.

"Against the threats facing us today, I wish we could increase it because the need is growing, the weapons are more sophisticated and much more expensive," Mordechai said when asked by Israel's Jerusalem Post if there was an intention to reduce U.S. military aid.
Israel gets the largest chunk of U.S. foreign aid, which includes $1.2 billion in economic aid for a yearly total of $3 billion.

In July, new Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pledged in a speech to the U.S. Congress: "In the next four years, we are going to begin the long-term process of gradually reducing the level of your generous economic assistance."
Mordechai is to make his first visit to Washington as defence minister next week.
